mechanistic_edges.subject: UniProtKB:O86041
mechanistic_edges.description: Ralstonia sp. U2 NagI catalysis is supported by the original study; the native ENZRXN records unpurified heterologous-host assays, not a claim that all assayed preparations were purified.

evidence.source_assertion: The reviewed entry assigns RHEA:18237 catalytic activity to NagI with ECO:0000269 citing PMID:11133965. Its cited genomic sequence is from strain U2.

mechanistic_edges.subject: UniProtKB:O86043
mechanistic_edges.description: Glutathione is a catalytic cofactor of the U2 isomerase, not a stoichiometric reactant in the net isomerization.

evidence.source_assertion: The COFACTOR comment identifies glutathione (CHEBI:57925) with ECO:0000269 citing PMID:18824004.

mechanistic_edges.subject: UniProtKB:O86042
mechanistic_edges.description: The reviewed UniProt entry annotates this metal by similarity (ECO:0000250). It does not establish direct U2 cofactor measurements or simultaneous occupancy with the alternative metal.

evidence.source_assertion: The COFACTOR comment lists Mg(2+) (CHEBI:18420) with ECO:0000250 (by similarity), without a direct experimental citation.

mechanistic_edges.subject: MetaCyc:G18NG-12642-MONOMER
mechanistic_edges.description: This separate Corynebacterium glutamicum ATCC 13032 isomerase example is not the U2 NagL enzyme. Native source reports purified heterologous-host assays; primary construct details require their own qualifier if a tagged preparation is asserted.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-16404 links enzyme G18NG-12642-MONOMER to MALEYLPYRUVATE-ISOMERASE-RXN; its evidence entries cite PMID:16000747 and PMID:16481315 with EV-EXP-IDA-PURIFIED-PROTEIN-HH.

mechanistic_edges.subject: MetaCyc:G18NG-12642-MONOMER
mechanistic_edges.description: Mycothiol dependence belongs to the C. glutamicum enzyme; it must not be assigned to U2 NagL or represented as generic glutathione independence for every gentisate isomerase.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-16404 has cofactor CPD1G-2 (mycothiol) with citation PMID:16481315. The enzyme is G18NG-12642-MONOMER.
